shared_elements: worked stone surface with low-relief projections
justification: A carries a dense figural programme — a row of birds, quadrupeds, a canid, small human-like figures and a band of chevron/net pattern arranged in registers on a T-shaped pillar — while B shows essentially no figural imagery at all, only a rock face with rectangular pillar-like masses left in relief. The only correspondence is the generic shape of an upright rectangular monolith standing proud of surrounding rock, which any stone-working tradition could produce independently.
